zh-CN.name: REA 逆向分析
zh-CN.summary: 基于证据分析二进制、软件包与应用行为。需另备受支持的 Node.js/npm、rea-agents CLI 或已注册的 REA MCP；原生分析等流程需另备目标相关工具及权限，商业提供方须另行授权付费。安装本技能仅提供指引，不安装工具或注册服务；依赖不可用时先处理阻碍，不编造结果。

en-US.name: REA: Reverse Engineer Anything
en-US.summary: Evidence-led reverse analysis of binaries, packages and app behavior. Requires supported Node.js/npm and rea-agents CLI or a registered REA MCP server; target-specific tools, permissions and any commercial provider licenses are separate. Installing this skill only supplies instructions; it does not install tools or register services. Resolve missing dependencies before claiming results.

requirements.value: 需 Node.js ^22.19.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0 及 npm；requires the supported Node.js range and npm.
另备 rea-agents CLI；MCP 工作流需另注册 REA MCP，并核对实际工具列表/版本。CLI-only hosts can use the separately acquired CLI; this skill neither installs REA nor registers an MCP server.

目标相关工具另备，例如原生分析 Hopper/Ghidra/IDA，Android JADX/JDK/adb，固件 Binwalk/Unblob。Target-specific tools and their supported hosts are separate; commercial Hopper/IDA/JEB providers require their own licenses and costs.

仅分析已获授权的目标；运行时操作需相应系统权限与授权，缺工具/连接时先解决或停止，不虚构成功。Use authorized targets; runtime observation needs applicable OS/user approvals. Resolve unavailable dependencies or stop before unsupported calls; never fabricate results.
